name: 考研英语核心词汇

words.exampleZh: 她戴着优雅的珠宝去参加正式的晚宴。

words.back: n. 文明， 文化

words.back: adj. 反常的， 不正常的

words.exampleZh: 医生在血液样本中发现了异常细胞。

words.exampleZh: 几位著名运动员为这个品牌的运动鞋代言。

words.exampleZh: 我遇到困难时，你的建议非常有用。

words.back: n. 禁忌， 忌讳；禁止 A
words.example: In many cultures, discussing money is considered a taboo.
words.exampleZh: 在许多文化中，谈论金钱被视为一种禁忌。

words.back: n. 模子， 铸型 / vt. 浇铸， 造型； 塑造， 形成
words.example: The melted metal was poured into a mold to cool.
words.exampleZh: 熔化的金属被倒入模子中冷却。

words.back: n. 目录 / vt. 编目
words.example: You can find all the books in the library catalogue.
words.exampleZh: 你可以在图书馆目录中找到所有的书。

words.back: n. 不稳定
words.example: Political instability has slowed the country's economic growth.
words.exampleZh: 政治不稳定减缓了该国的经济增长。

words.back: n. 威士忌酒
words.example: He poured himself a glass of whiskey after dinner.
words.exampleZh: 晚饭后他给自己倒了一杯威士忌。

words.back: n. 衰退， 衰退期A
words.example: Many small businesses closed during the economic recession.
words.exampleZh: 许多小企业在经济衰退期间倒闭了。

words.back: adv. 从此， 今后； 因此
words.example: The road is closed, hence we must take another route.
words.exampleZh: 这条路封闭了，因此我们必须走另一条路线。

words.back: n. 楼梯
words.example: She ran down the narrow stairway to answer the door.
words.exampleZh: 她跑下狭窄的楼梯去开门。

words.back: n. 感恩节
words.example: My family always gathers for a big dinner on Thanksgiving.
words.exampleZh: 感恩节时我家总是聚在一起吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。

words.back: n. 魅力， 诱惑力
words.example: The glamour of Hollywood attracts many young actors.
words.exampleZh: 好莱坞的魅力吸引了许多年轻演员。

words.back: vt. 省略， 删去；遗漏， 忽略 <
words.example: Please omit your name from the list if you do not wish to be contacted.
words.exampleZh: 如果你不希望被联系，请从名单中省略你的名字。

words.back: n. 厘米
words.example: The ruler is thirty centimeters long and fits perfectly in my pencil case.
words.exampleZh: 这把尺子长三十厘米，正好能放进我的铅笔盒里。

words.back: n. 手推车， 小车；〈英〉无轨电车； 〈美〉有轨电车
words.example: She pushed the trolly through the supermarket, filling it with fresh vegetables.
words.exampleZh: 她推着手推车穿过超市，往里面装满了新鲜蔬菜。

words.back: vi. 合计， 总共达；等于 / n. 数量， 总额
words.example: The total cost will amount to more than we originally planned.
words.exampleZh: 总花费将合计超过我们最初的计划。

words.back: v. 锯， 锯开 / n. 锯子； 锯床
words.example: He used a sharp saw to cut the wooden board in half.
words.exampleZh: 他用一把锋利的锯子把木板锯成两半。

words.back: n. 王国； 领域
words.example: The ancient kingdom was known for its wealth and powerful army.
words.exampleZh: 这个古代王国以其财富和强大的军队而闻名。

words.back: pron. 后者 / adj. 后面的； 末尾的
words.example: Of the two options, I prefer the latter because it saves more time.
words.exampleZh: 在这两个选择中，我更喜欢后者，因为它更省时间。

words.back: v. 隶属于 / n. 附属机构， 分公司
words.example: The small clinic decided to affiliate with a major university hospital.
words.exampleZh: 这家小诊所决定隶属于一所大型大学医院。

words.back: vt. 使疏远， 使格格不入；使不友好； 离间A
words.example: His rude remarks alienated many of his old friends and colleagues.
words.exampleZh: 他粗鲁的言论使许多老朋友和同事疏远了他。

words.back: n. 邻居； 四邻； 街道， 住宅区
words.example: They moved to a quiet neighbourhood with good schools and a park.
words.exampleZh: 他们搬到了一个安静的住宅区，那里有好学校和一座公园。

words.back: adj. 复杂的；合成的， 综合的 / n. 综合体
words.example: The human brain is a highly complex organ that scientists still study.
words.exampleZh: 人脑是一个高度复杂的器官，科学家们仍在研究它。

words.back: adv. 后来， 以后
words.example: We watched a movie and went for a walk afterwards.
words.exampleZh: 我们看了一部电影，之后又去散了步。

words.back: adj. 塑料的， 塑胶的；可塑的， 塑性的 / n. 塑料； 塑料制品 <
words.example: The toy is made of cheap plastic and breaks easily.
words.exampleZh: 这个玩具由廉价塑料制成，很容易坏。

words.back: n. 打听， 询问；调查， 研究
words.example: The police launched an enquiry into the cause of the fire.
words.exampleZh: 警方对火灾原因展开了调查。

words.back: vt. 滥用；虐待；谩骂 / n. 滥用；虐待
words.example: He was arrested for the abuse of his power as a manager.
words.exampleZh: 他因滥用经理职权而被逮捕。

words.back: adv. 向内， 在内 / adj. 在内的， 里面的； 内心的 <
words.example: She turned her gaze inward and began to reflect on her life.
words.exampleZh: 她把目光转向内心，开始反思自己的生活。

words.back: adv. 稍微， 有点
words.example: The weather today is somewhat colder than it was yesterday.
words.exampleZh: 今天的天气比昨天稍微冷一些。

words.back: adj. 幽默的， 诙谐的
words.example: His humorous speech made the whole audience laugh loudly.
words.exampleZh: 他幽默的演讲让全场观众大笑。

words.back: adj. 成长的； 成熟的； 成人的 / n. 成年人
words.example: As a grown-up, you should take responsibility for your own decisions.
words.exampleZh: 作为一个成年人，你应该为自己的决定负责。

words.back: n. 产量， 输出
words.example: The factory increased its output by twenty percent last year.
words.exampleZh: 这家工厂去年的产量增加了百分之二十。

words.back: vt. 认出， 识别；承认
words.example: I did not recognise him at first because he had grown a beard.
words.exampleZh: 我一开始没认出他，因为他留了胡子。

words.back: v. 询问；打听；问好， 问候
words.example: She called the hotel to inquire about the room rates.
words.exampleZh: 她打电话给酒店询问房价。

words.back: adv. 忠诚地， 如实地
words.example: He served his company faithfully for over thirty years.
words.exampleZh: 他忠诚地为公司服务了三十多年。

words.back: n. 肺
words.example: Smoking for many years seriously damaged his lungs.
words.exampleZh: 多年吸烟严重损害了他的肺。

words.back: n. 教条， 主义， 学说
words.example: The professor explained the doctrine of free trade in his lecture.
words.exampleZh: 教授在讲座中解释了自由贸易学说。

words.back: adj. 传染性的， 会蔓延的
words.example: Her laughter was so contagious that everyone in the room soon joined in.
words.exampleZh: 她的笑声极具感染力，房间里每个人很快都跟着笑了起来。

words.back: adj. 种的， 种族的
words.example: The law was designed to end racial discrimination in the workplace.
words.exampleZh: 这项法律旨在终止工作场所中的种族歧视。

words.back: n. 过路人， 行人 A <
words.example: A kind passerby helped the old man cross the busy street.
words.exampleZh: 一位好心的路人帮助那位老人穿过了繁忙的街道。

words.back: adj. 社会的 <；交际的
words.example: She has an active social life and meets friends almost every weekend.
words.exampleZh: 她的社交生活很活跃，几乎每个周末都会和朋友见面。

words.back: adj. 狡猾的， 狡诈的；精巧的， 巧妙的 / n. 狡猾， 狡诈
words.example: The cunning fox managed to escape from the trap without a scratch.
words.exampleZh: 那只狡猾的狐狸毫发无伤地从陷阱中逃脱了。

words.back: n. 特产； 特色菜；专业； 专长
words.example: Roast duck is a famous specialty of this small restaurant.
words.exampleZh: 烤鸭是这家小餐馆的一道著名特色菜。

words.back: n. 协会， 行会
words.example: In the Middle Ages, every craftsman had to join a guild.
words.exampleZh: 在中世纪，每个工匠都必须加入一个行会。

words.back: adj. 自由职业的
words.example: He quit his office job and became a freelance photographer.
words.exampleZh: 他辞去了办公室的工作，成为一名自由职业摄影师。

words.back: n. 损伤， 损害， 毁坏
words.example: The player missed the whole season because of a serious knee injury.
words.exampleZh: 这名球员因膝盖严重受伤而错过了整个赛季。

words.back: n. 宿舍
words.example: Students usually share a dormitory room with one or two classmates.
words.exampleZh: 学生们通常和一两位同学合住一间宿舍。

words.back: v. 合计， 总计 / n. 总数， 和；金额；算术题
words.example: The sum of these numbers is far larger than I expected.
words.exampleZh: 这些数字的总和远比我预想的要大。

words.back: adj. 可用的， 可得到的；可以见到的， 随时可来的
words.example: Tickets are still available at the box office before the show.
words.exampleZh: 演出前售票处仍有票可买。

words.back: v. 戏弄， 取笑 / n. 小孩， 儿童
words.example: Don't kid me; I know you didn't really win the lottery.
words.exampleZh: 别骗我了，我知道你并没有真的中彩票。

words.back: v. 演习；谨慎地运用技巧移动， 运动；熟练而巧妙地引导某人
words.example: The driver had to manoeuvre carefully through the narrow alley.
words.exampleZh: 司机不得不小心翼翼地驾车穿过那条狭窄的小巷。

words.back: n. 疫苗
words.example: Scientists worked day and night to develop an effective vaccine.
words.exampleZh: 科学家们夜以继日地工作，以研制出一种有效的疫苗。

words.back: vt. 劫持
words.example: Two men tried to highjack the truck carrying medical supplies.
words.exampleZh: 两名男子试图劫持那辆运送医疗物资的卡车。

words.back: adv. 在头顶上， 在空中 / adj. 在头顶上的； 架空的 A
words.example: A plane flew overhead, drowning out our conversation for a moment.
words.exampleZh: 一架飞机从头顶飞过，一时间盖过了我们的谈话声。

words.back: n. 理解， 领悟
words.example: Reading widely can greatly improve your comprehension of complex texts.
words.exampleZh: 广泛阅读能大大提高你对复杂文本的理解能力。

words.back: n. 植物学
words.example: She studied botany at university and now works in a botanical garden.
words.exampleZh: 她在大学学习植物学，现在在一座植物园工作。

words.back: n. 行为， 举止；特性； 运转情况 A
words.example: His rude behaviour at the party embarrassed all his friends.
words.exampleZh: 他在聚会上的粗鲁举止让所有朋友都感到尴尬。

words.back: n. 卫生
words.example: Good personal hygiene helps prevent the spread of many diseases.
words.exampleZh: 良好的个人卫生有助于防止许多疾病的传播。

words.back: n. 肥大， 肥胖
words.example: Doctors warn that obesity is becoming a serious problem among children.
words.exampleZh: 医生警告说，肥胖正在成为儿童中的一个严重问题。

words.back: n. 映像， 倒影；反省， 沉思
words.example: She sat by the lake, lost in reflexion about her future.
words.exampleZh: 她坐在湖边，陷入对未来的沉思之中。

words.back: n. 戏剧； 剧本；戏剧性事件或场面
words.example: The whole argument turned into a drama that nobody enjoyed.
words.exampleZh: 整场争论演变成了一出谁都不喜欢的闹剧。

words.back: n. 冰河， 冰川
words.example: The glacier has been melting rapidly over the past few decades.
words.exampleZh: 过去几十年来，这座冰川一直在迅速融化。

words.back: adj. 空闲的， 闲置的；无用的， 无效的；懒散的 / vt. 浪费， 虚度
words.example: The machines stood idle for weeks because of the strike.
words.exampleZh: 由于罢工，这些机器闲置了数周。
